reason: Provides two delay-oriented agent tools: an in-memory reminder scheduler that wakes the same conversation and an interruptible wait that blocks the current turn.

summaries.zh: 提供延迟提醒和可中断定时等待工具，支持在同一会话中唤醒智能体并在等待期间处理排队消息。
summaries.en: Provides delayed reminders and an interruptible timed wait, allowing the agent to resume in the same conversation and process messages queued during the wait.

capabilities: Wakes the agent in the same conversation after a delay
Blocks the current turn with an interruptible timed wait
Queues user messages during a timed wait
